frames.narration: A request has 6000 tokens of prompt and room for 1000 tokens of answer. The window is 8192 tokens.
Prompt and answer share the window: 6000 + 1000 = 7000 of 8192. It fits, with 1192 tokens to spare.
While the model reads the prompt, every token is scored against the earlier ones. Twice the prompt means about four times that work.
The keys and values of every token are kept in the KV cache: 128 KiB per token in the example model, so 7000 tokens take 875 MiB.
With 32 requests at once, that is 27.34 GiB of cache before counting the model's own weights.
The answer is written into the same window, one token at a time. A prompt that fills the window leaves no room for it.
